JUNIOR FULL STACK DEVELOPER

Secaucus, NJ
Job Type
Full-time
Description
Junior Full Stack Developer (Hybrid)

About Us:

For over 100 years, Hartz has been driven by one belief: pets make life better. That belief fuels our commitment to creating innovative, trusted products that strengthen the bond between pets and their families.

Our diverse team of passionate professionals continuously reimagine what pet care can be—working collaboratively to improve the wellbeing of pets everywhere. We’re proud to offer an inclusive, flexible workplace where employees are supported, valued, and empowered to grow.

At Hartz, the work you do matters—far beyond our walls. Join us and help shape the next chapter of pet care innovation.

What We Offer …

Hybrid Work Schedule: Enjoy flexibility with 3 days in-office and 2 days remote.
Pet-Friendly Culture: Bring your pet to work and enjoy a casual, inclusive environment.
Competitive Compensation & Benefits: Receive a generous 401(k) match with immediate vesting.
Generous Paid Time Off: Enjoy up to 34 paid days off annually. 
Paid Leaves: Parental leave, Bereavement leave, and Military leave.
Comprehensive Health Coverage: Includes Medical, Dental, Vision, Healthcare FSA, and Mental Health EAP, basic Life insurance and Disability Insurance.
Tuition Reimbursement & Career Growth: Access to tuition reimbursement and other learning and development opportunities.
Employee Perks: Volunteer opportunities, fun employee events, and more!

The Role …

We're seeking an ambitious Junior Full Stack Developer to join our team and help create innovative web applications that deliver exceptional user experience. In this role, you'll gain hands-on experience across the entire Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), collaborating with experienced developers and business stakeholders to transform ideas into functional, scalable solutions. You'll contribute to frontend and backend development, participate in system design and testing activities, and help maintain applications that support critical business operations.

If you have a strong foundation in web development and a genuine curiosity for both frontend interfaces and backend systems, this is an excellent opportunity to expand your technical skills in a collaborative, hands-on environment. You’ll work with modern development technologies under the guidance of senior team members while gaining practical experience building and supporting production applications.

This position is located at our Secaucus, NJ corporate headquarters, with the flexibility to work a hybrid schedule. 

Your Responsibilities …

Application Development & Full Stack Engineering 

Assist in developing, maintaining, and supporting web applications using Microsoft ASP.NET Core, CSS, HTML, IIS, Azure, and ORACLE databases
Build responsive, interactive web application interfaces using frontend and backend technologies under team guidance
Develop and maintain server-side logic, data structures, and REST APIs to support secure and reliable communication between frontend and backend systems

Testing & Troubleshooting 

Test applications across different browsers and devices to ensure responsiveness, efficiency, and cross-browser compatibility
Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve basic issues across both front-end and back-end systems

Production Support, Maintenance, & Documentation 

Provide foundational support for application availability, monitor nightly batch jobs, and assist with software upgrades and data purges. Escalate critical production issues according to established procedures
Assist with general knowledge transfer, basic application configuration changes, and fulfilling ad-hoc report requests
Create and maintain technical documentation, setup guides, and user manuals
Requirements

  

You’ll Need …

Education and Experience: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field preferred, with 3+ years of relevant hands-on experience in full-stack development (this includes experience gained through internships, bootcamps, or personal project portfolios); or 5+ years of combined experience in lieu of degree
Technical Foundations: Foundational experience with Microsoft .NET Core / .NET Framework, C#, and a basic understanding of ORACLE PL/SQL, stored procedures, and triggers
Agile Adaptability: Familiarity with the Agile software development lifecycle and a basic understanding of version control tools like Azure DevOps or Git
Problem Solving Skills: Good debugging skills with a strong willingness to learn complex troubleshooting and system architecture
Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills to collaborate with developers and business stakeholders, clarify requirements, and communicate technical issues clearly
Team Collaboration: Work closely with the core development team and collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams to learn best practices, optimize application performance, and implement security protocols
Project Management Skills: Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize deadlines with moderate complexity
Technical Proficiency: Proficient in Microsoft Office programs (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and Google Office Suites

Highly Desired Experience & Skills …

Programming Languages: C#, JavaScript, HTML 5, CSS, SQL
Cloud Technologies: Experience with Cloud Platforms (Azure)
Development Tools & Environment: Microsoft .NET Framework and currently supported versions of .NET, Visual Studio, Azure DevOps, Git, Windows Server and IIS
Web & Database Technologies: AJAX, ASP.NET, REST APIs, Azure Services, Data Base Management Systems (Oracle Database, SQL)
Web Design & Compatibility: Strong knowledge of responsive design and cross-browser compatibility
Cybersecurity Skills: Foundational cybersecurity knowledge and security best practices to support the secure development, testing, and maintenance of web applications, APIs, and databases
UI/UX Design: User Interface (UI) and User Experience (UX) 

The anticipated salary range for this role is between $84,000 and $105,000. The specific salary offered will depend on the candidate’s qualifications and experience for this position. This role may also be eligible for an annual discretionary incentive award.

If this sounds like a good match and you want to learn more about this exciting role, please get in touch with us today!

Hartz is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age or any other characteristic protected by law.
